name: Prague Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest is 06/24, 3,715 m long and 45 m wide (12/30 is 3,250 m × 45 m)

handling.v: business aviation handling by Bell Textron Prague, ABS Jets and Time Air (all-flight handlers: Czech Airlines Handling, Menzies Aviation, Czech GH)
handling.quote: ABS Jets, a.s. − Business Aviation Handling

fuel.v: Jet A-1 and AVGAS 100LL, fuelling H24
fuel.quote: Fuel: Turbo Fuel JET A-1, AVGAS 100 LL

noise.v: the operator states a limited number of coordinated operations in the night period and restricted access for aircraft without ICAO Annex 16 noise certification; details in AIP LKPR AD 2.21
noise.quote: Limited number of coordinated operations in night time period.

curfew.v: from 2100 to 0500 UTC (summer 2000 to 0400 UTC), i.e. 22:00-06:00 local all year: aircraft over 45 t MTOW may not take off or land unless their type is on the airport's list of types permitted for night operation; aircraft up to 45 t MTOW are permitted if they meet noise categories 1 to 9 (GEN 4.1); the number of night flights is limited; other exemptions only from the aerodrome operator on request; delayed departures and arrivals allowed until 2200 UTC (summer 2100 UTC), i.e. 23:00 local
curfew.quote: Take-offs and landings of aircraft with MTOW less or equal to 45 t are permitted from 2100 (2000) to 0500 (0400).

slots.v: coordinated airport; arrival and departure slots must be requested before every flight (except emergency, life-saving and search-and-rescue flights); slot coordination H24
slots.quote: PRAHA/Ruzyně Airport is a co-ordinated airport.

max_aircraft.v: available for aircraft up to Boeing 747-400 size (wingspan 65 m, length 71 m); larger types only under the conditions of AD 2.20 para 5
max_aircraft.quote: LKPR is available for aircraft up to size of Boeing 747-400 (wingspan 65 m, fuselage length 71 m).

notes: The ANS CR HTML page (effective 1 Oct 2026) ends after AD 2.17; AD 2.18–2.24 (local regulations, noise and night rules) are in a separate PDF that could not be opened (permission not given in time).
